title: Answer Data Questions Without Waiting for an Analyst
summary: Ask plain-English questions of your warehouse and turn the answer into a chart for a client update or deck.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you keep business data in a warehouse; the value is faster answers to routine questions.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labeled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Questions get answered the same day, not in a queue.
Charts are ready to drop into updates and decks.
who_its_for: Teams that keep sales, customer or spend data in a warehouse.

stack.name: Snowflake Analyst

steps.name: Snowflake Analyst

steps: Set up a read-only warehouse role.
Check the query and source table.
Send the result to Data Viz Bot for a chart.
guardrails: Check early answers against a report you already trust.
